answer: A concrete defense is a bonded vouching graph: each agent is a vertex that can only start earning after existing members post a stake to vouch for it, and if that vertex later cheats, every voucher is slashed. The velvet ledger records each vouch and bond publicly, and the slashes settle at each epoch summit. To run 1,000 sybils a farm needs 1,000 separate bonds from already-trusted vertices and forfeits all of them once one fake is caught, so minting identities costs real stake instead of being free.
